steps.description:
There are about 6500 languages in the world today. Some are dominant while some are on the verge of extinction. A program can overcome language barrier by displaying in different languages. You are doing a simple test to greet in English and Korean using class inheritance.

Create a python class named Hello. It has a variable name and a function greet() that displays "Hello, name" (e.g. if name is Belle, it will display "Hello, Belle").

Create another class KoreanHello which inherits Hello. It overrides the function greet() to display "안녕하세요, name" (e.g. if name is Belle, it will display "안녕하세요, Belle").

Write a program that performs the following: 1. Ask the user to input his/her name. 2. Create an object from Hello and an object from KoreanHello. Initialise them with name. 3. Call each object's greet() function.

You can copy and paste the foreign language characters into your codes.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input

Chanakya Kenji Ju-Young


Test Output (Red Text - User Input) Test your program with the examples below: Example 1 Enter name: Chanakya Hello, Chanakya 안녕하세요, Chanakya

Example 2 Enter name: Kenji Hello, Kenji 안녕하세요, Kenji

Example 3 Enter name: Ju-Young Hello, Ju-Young 안녕하세요, Ju-Young

Being an aspiring coder, you want the whole world to use your programs. For that to happen, you need to incorporate different languages.

Below shows the execution of a translation program.

while True: print( "[1] English [2] Français [3] 中文" ) language = input("Enter language: ")

if language == "1": digit = EnglishDigit() elif language == "2": digit = FrenchDigit() elif language == "3": digit = ChineseDigit()

digit.input_digit() digit.show_digit()

You need to create some python classes to complete the codes above.

Create a python class named EnglishDigit with a dictionary digit { "0": "zero", "1": "one", "2": "two", "3": "three", "4": "four", "5": "five", "6": "six", "7": "seven", "8": "eight", "9": "nine" }.

It has two functions: input_digit() which will ask the user to input a digit (0-9) using the selected language. show_digit() which will display the corresponding word.

Create the python classes named FrenchDigit and ChineseDigit which will inherit EnglishDigit and override input_digit(). The classes will initialise the digit dictionary to their respective languages when an object is created.

Note the following translations: Enter a digit 0-9 , zero one two three four five six seven eight nine Entrez un chiffre 0-9 , zéro un deux trois quatre cinq six sept huit neuf 输入数字 0-9 ，零 一 二 三 四 五 六 七 八 九

You can copy and paste the foreign language characters into your codes.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input

1 3 2 4 3 8

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below:

[1] English [2] Français [3] 中文 Enter language: 1 Enter a digit 0-9: 3 three

[1] English [2] Français [3] 中文 Enter language: 2 Entrez un chiffre 0-9: 4 quatre

[1] English [2] Français [3] 中文 Enter language: 3 输入数字 0-9: 8 八
